fields.description: The fields a site has added to Education's doctypes for what Education has no field for. Each is the fieldname of a field on that doctype; left blank, the register at /commons/attendance does without it.
fields.label: Marks

fields.description: A Check field on Student Attendance marking a student present but late. Blank: the register offers no Late mark.
fields.label: Late Arrival Field

fields.description: The share of a session's hours a late arrival earns, from 0 to 1. 1 counts it as fully present.
fields.label: Late Arrival Credit

fields.description: A Data or Select field on Course Schedule naming the kind of session. The register groups and totals by it. Blank: no grouping by type.
fields.label: Session Type Field

fields.description: A text field on Course Schedule describing the session, shown and edited beside it.
fields.label: Session Details Field

fields.description: A Check field on Academic Term retiring a term. Ticked terms are left out of the register. Blank: every term is offered.
fields.label: Inactive Term Field
